title: Link two nodes
explanation:
Each node holds a value and a pointer to the next node.
A null next pointer marks the end of the list.

questions.prompt: Which line links a to b as its next node?
questions.hint: Find the node whose next field should hold the address of b.

options.feedback: a.next stores the address of b.
This points b back to a.
A null next pointer leaves a at the end.

questions.prompt: Which expression reads the second node's value?
questions.hint: Follow a.next to the second node. A pointer reaches a field with ->.

options.feedback: a.next points to b, and -> reads its value, 8.
a.value is the first node's value, 4.
a.next is a pointer. Use -> to reach the field.
